> [!IMPORTANT]
> Please keep pull requests focused and tested. Unreviewed AI-generated code,
> invented dependencies, and blind copy-pastes will be closed without review.

---

### Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed and understand the changes.
- [ ] I tested the change locally with `npm start`.
- [ ] I ran `node --check` on the modified JavaScript files.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal paths are included.
